27900.commentary: (DNa) tattha yasmā so bhagavato dhammakathaṃ sutvā dasasahass'ādhikassa janasatasahassassa jeṭṭhako hutvā sot'āpanno jāto, tasmā janavasabho'ti'ssa nāmaṃ ahosi.

examples.text: atha kho, ānanda, antarahito yakkho saddam'anussāvesi, janavasabho ahaṃ bhagavā, janavasabho ahaṃ sugatā'ti. abhijānāsi no tvaṃ, ānanda, ito pubbe evarūpaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ sutaṃ yadidaṃ janavasabho'ti?

27903.meaning1: things which people gossip about; rumours which the people talk about

examples.text: cudito vacībhi satim'ābhinande, sabrahmacārīsu khilaṃ pabhinde, vācaṃ pamuñce kusalaṃ n'ātivelaṃ, janavādadhammāya na cetayeyya.

27904.meaning1: devoid of people; secluded from people

examples.text: pamādam'anuyuñjanti, bālā dummedhino janā, appamādañ'ca medhāvī, dhanaṃ seṭṭhaṃ'va rakkhati.
diṭṭhā'pi sutā'pi te janā, yesaṃ nāmam'idaṃ pavuccati, nāmaṃ yev'āvasissati, akkheyyaṃ petassa jantuno.
itthī'pi hi ekacciyā, seyyā posa janādhipa, medhāvinī sīlavatī, sassudevā patibbatā.

27908.meaning1: producing; generating; causing; creating; giving birth

27909.commentary: (MNa) janikā mātā'ti yāya tumhe janitā, sā vo janikā mātā. janikāmātū'ti janikāya mātu.

examples.text: jānanti pana bhonto, yā janikā mātā brāhmaṇaṃ'y'eva agamāsi, no abrāhmaṇan'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho.
jānanti pana bhonto, yā janikāmātu mātā yāva sattamā mātumātāmahayugā brāhmaṇaṃ'y'eva agamāsi, no abrāhmaṇan'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho.

27911.synonym: abhinibbatta, abhinimmita, uppādita, pakata, samuṭṭhāpita, sambhūta

examples.text: puthujjā'ti puthujjanehi janitā sammutiyo'ti puthujjā, puthu nānājanehi janitā vā sammutiyo'ti puthujjā'ti, yā kāc'imā sammutiyo puthujjā.
kammajanito'pi hi ayaṃ kāyo kabaḷīkār'āhārena upatthambhito dasa'pi vassāni vassasatam'pi yāva āyuparimāṇaṃ tiṭṭhati.

27912.commentary: (DNa) jan'indan'ti sabbalok'uttamaṃ. (JAa) jan'indā'ti rājānaṃ ālapati. rājā hi param'issarabhāvena janassa indo'ti jan'indo.

examples.text: buddho jan'ind'atthi manussaloke, kām'ābhibhū sakyamunī'ti ñāyati, tass'eva te puttā satiyā vihīnā, coditā mayā te satim'ajjhalatthuṃ.
tvaṃ āvikarohi bhūmipāla, bhattā bhārasaho tuvaṃ vade taṃ, tava chandarucīni sammasitvā, atha vakkhanti jan'inda pañca dhīrā.
jānanti pana bhonto yo janipitā brāhmaṇiṃ'y'eva agamāsi, no abrāhmaṇin'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho.

27914.commentary: (MNa) janikā mātā'ti yāya tumhe janitā, sā vo janikā mātā. janikāmātū'ti janikāya mātu.

examples.text: jānanti pana bhonto, yā janimātā brāhmaṇaṃ'y'eva agamāsi, no abrāhmaṇan'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho.
khattiyo seṭṭho janetasmiṃ, ye gottapaṭisārino, vijjācaraṇasampanno, so seṭṭho devamānuse'ti.

27919.meaning1: should be generated; should be produced

27921.synonym: āharati, uppādayati, uppādeti, nipphādeti, pasavati, pasaveti, pātukaroti, savati

examples.text: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sammāvāyāmo.
taṇhā janeti purisaṃ, cittam'assa vidhāvati, satto saṃsāram'āpādi, dukkham'assa mahabbhayan'ti.

27923.synonym: ayyā, jananī, janikā, matti, mātar, mātu
27923.notes: a rare case of Sanskrit -trī, Pāḷi -ttī

examples.text: visāradā'va bhaṇasi, etam'atthaṃ janetti me, maññāmi nūna māmike, vanatho te na vijjati.
sādhū hi kira me mātā, patodaṃ upadaṃsayi, yass'āhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, anusiṭṭho janettiyā, āraddhavīriyo pahit'atto, patto sambodhim'uttamaṃ.

27924.meaning1: having produced; having generated; having caused

examples.text: sā taṃ sālaṃ anuparihareyya. sā taṃ sālaṃ anupariharitvā upari viṭabhiṃ kareyya. upari viṭabhiṃ karitvā oghanaṃ janeyya. oghanaṃ janetvā ye tassa sālassa mahantā mahantā khandhā te padāleyya.
panādo opamañño ca, devasūto ca mātali, cittaseno ca gandhabbo, naḷo rājā jan'esabho.

27927.meaning1: well known among men; famous among humans
27927.commentary: (DNa) janesutā'ti jane vissutā pākaṭā abhiññātā. (MNt) janesutā'ti jane sakalasattaloke vissutā, patthaṭayasā'ti attho.

examples.text: sabbe vijitasaṅgāmā, bhay'ātītā yasassino, modanti saha bhūtehi, sāvakā te janesutā'ti.

27928.commentary: (DNa) jan'ogham'aparena cā'ti etassa aparabhāge jan'oghaṃ nāma aññaṃ nagaraṃ.

examples.text: uttarena kasivanto, jan'ogham'aparena ca, navanavutiyo ambara-ambaravatiyo, āḷakamandā nāma rājadhānī.
cittaseno ca gandhabbo, naḷorājā jan'osabho, āgā pañcasikho c'eva, timbarū sūriyavaccasā.

tasmā jantu sadā sato, kāmāni parivajjaye, te pahāya tare oghaṃ, nāvaṃ sitvā'va pāragū'ti.

examples.text: dhamme ca jhāne ca ratā ahesuṃ, te brāhmaṇā ye purāṇaṃ saranti, ime ca vokkamma japāmase'ti, gottena mattā visamaṃ caranti.
na juhe na jape mante, aggihuttaṃ pahāpitaṃ, ko nu me pāricariyāya, pubbe cittaṃ palobhayi.

27946.commentary: (SNPa) idāni dhammasandosavādan'ti ettha atisaṅkhepena vuttaṃ samathavipassanāyuttassa bhikkhuno upakkilesaṃ pākaṭaṃ karonto tadaññena'pi upakkilesena saddhiṃ hassaṃ jappan'ti imaṃ gātham'āha. hāsan'ti'pi pāṭho. vipassakena hi bhikkhunā hasanīyasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ sitamattam'eva kātabbaṃ, niratthakakathājappo na bhāsitabbo, ñātibyasan'ādīsu paridevo na kātabbo, khāṇukaṇṭak'ādimhi manopadoso na uppādetabbo.

examples.text: hassaṃ jappaṃ paridevaṃ padosaṃ, māyākataṃ kuhanaṃ giddhi mānaṃ, sārambhaṃ kakkasaṃ kasāvañ'ca mucchaṃ, hitvā care vītamado ṭhit'atto.
jappena mantena subhāsitena, anuppadānena paveṇiyā vā, yathā yathā yattha labhetha atthaṃ, tathā tathā tattha parakkameyya.
yo c'īdha kammaṃ kurute pamāya, thāmabbalaṃ attani saṃviditvā, jappena mantena subhāsitena, parikkhavā so vipulaṃ jinātī'ti.

27948.synonym: abhinandati, kāmeti, nikāmeti, pajappati, piheti, pīhayati

examples.text: na diṭṭhiyā na sutiyā na ñāṇena, sīlabbaten'āpi na suddhim'āha, adiṭṭhiyā assutiyā añāṇā, asīlatā abbatā no'pi tena, ete ca nissajja anuggahāya, santo anissāya bhavaṃ na jappe.

27953.commentary: (SNa) bahum'pi palapaṃ jappan'ti bahum'pi palapaṃ jappanto, brāhmaṇo'va sujjhatī'ti evaṃ vacanasahassam'pi bhaṇanto'ti attho.

examples.text: bahum'pi palapaṃ jappaṃ, na jaccā hoti brāhmaṇo, antokasambu saṅkiliṭṭho, kuhanaṃ upanissito.

27959.meaning1: could desire; would long; could yearn (for)

examples.text: na diṭṭhiyā na sutiyā na ñāṇena, sīlabbaten'āpi na suddhim'āha, adiṭṭhiyā assutiyā añāṇā, asīlatā abbatā no'pi tena, ete ca nissajja anuggahāya, santo anissāya bhavaṃ na jappe.

27963.commentary: (ANa) jambālī'ti gāmato nikkhantassa mahāudakassa patiṭṭhānabhūto mahāāvāṭo. (AP) jambālī oligallo ca, gāmadvāramhi kāsuyaṃ

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, jambālī anekavassagaṇikā. tassā puriso yāni c'eva āyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya, yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni vivareyya, devo ca na sammā dhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.

27978.meaning1: India; name of the central continent in Buddhist cosmology
27978.meaning2: country of the rose-apples; i.e. India

rājā arahasi bhavituṃ, cakkavattī rath'esabho, cāturanto vijitāvī, jambusaṇḍassa issaro.
seyyathā'pi bhikkhave, ye keci jambudīpakā rukkhā, jambū tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati, evam'eva kho bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhiyā dhammā, paññ'indriyaṃ tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati, yadidaṃ, bodhāya.

27987.meaning2: sort of gold coming from the Jambu river
27987.commentary: (SNa) jambonadan'ti mahājambusākhāya pavattanadiyaṃ nibbattaṃ, mahājambuphalarase vā pathaviyaṃ paviṭṭhe suvaṇṇ'aṅkurā uṭṭhahanti, tena suvaṇṇena kat'apiḷandhanan'ti'pi attho.

examples.text: nikkhaṃ jambonadass'eva, ko taṃ ninditum'arahati, devā'pi naṃ pasaṃsanti, brahmunā'pi pasaṃsito.

27991.commentary: (THIa) dhi tav'atthu jare jamme'ti aṅgānaṃ sithilabhāvakaraṇ'ādinā jare jamme lāmake hīne tava tuyhaṃ dhi atthu dhikāro hotu.

examples.text: pañcakkhandhā pariññātā, tiṭṭhanti chinnamūlakā, dhi tavatthu jare jamme, n'atthi dāni punabbhavo'ti.

27993.commentary: (SNa) dhī taṃ jammi jare atthū'ti lāmake jare dhī taṃ tuyhaṃ hotu, dhikkāro taṃ phusatu. (JAa) jammin'ti lāmikaṃ dandhaṃ.

examples.text: yaṃ esā sahate jammī, taṇhā loke visattikā, sokā tassa pavaḍḍhanti, abhivaṭṭhaṃ'va bīraṇaṃ.
dhī taṃ jammi jare atthu, dubbaṇṇakaraṇī jare, tāva manoramaṃ bimbaṃ, jarāya abhimadditaṃ.
jayaṃ ve maññati bālo, vācāya pharusaṃ bhaṇaṃ, jayañ'c'ev'assa taṃ hoti, yā titikkhā vijānato.
jayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, dukkhaṃ seti parājito, upasanto sukhaṃ seti, hitvā jayaparājayaṃ.
